edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the proposal creator and validated against proposition power
cancel authorizes through validateProposalCancellation on the stored proposal creator
submitVote lets msg.sender cast its own voting power
onlyAdmin modifier gates executeTransaction on msg.sender equality with _admin
onlyPendingAdmin lets msg.sender become the admin through acceptAdmin
onlyPriorityController checks msg.sender in the priority controller mapping
claimRewardsFor checks CLAIM_OPERATOR_ROLE or the per-user allowlist for msg.sender
writeOracleData requires msg.sender to equal ORACLE_EXTERNAL_ADAPTER
queue derives executionTime from block.timestamp plus the executor delay
queueTransaction requires executionTime to be at least block.timestamp plus delay
executeTransaction compares block.timestamp against executionTime and the grace period
proposeRoot sets the waiting period end from block.timestamp
updateRoot requires block.timestamp to exceed the waiting period end
permit requires block.timestamp to be at or before the deadline
delegateBySig requires block.timestamp to be at or before the expiry
mint requires block.timestamp to be past the minting restriction
claim computes the vested portion using block.timestamp
tx.origin is an untrusted origin; authorization must rely on msg.sender rather than tx.origin
execute loops over proposal targets performing external execution calls
the executor performs an arbitrary external call with attached value
executeTransaction invokes target.call with the proposal value
executeTransaction invokes target.delegatecall when withDelegatecall is set
delegatecall executes arbitrary code in the executor storage context including its admin
executeTransaction clears the queued flag for the action hash before calling out
the external call runs while the queued action state is being modified
queueTransaction records the action hash as queued
cancelTransaction records the action hash as no longer queued
a priority controller writes the unlock status of an action hash
the unlock status selects between the priority window and the normal timelock check
claimRewardsFor delegates to the internal claim routine
claimRewards delegates to the internal claim routine
the internal claim transfers reward tokens to the user
the claimed amount mapping is written around the external token transfer
the Chainlink oracle invokes the fulfillRequest callback after the request is sent
oracle data is written and then the request is recorded as fulfilled
submitVoteBySignature recovers the voter address with ecrecover
the recovered signer is passed as the voter into the internal vote routine
permit recovers the token owner address with ecrecover
delegateBySig recovers the delegator address with ecrecover
the proposals count is incremented when a new proposal is stored
the new proposal struct is written into the proposals mapping
the voting delay is added to the block number to compute the start block
the current governance strategy is recorded on the proposal
create requires the supplied executor to be in the authorized executors mapping
queue calls the internal queue helper for every proposal action
the queue helper calls queueTransaction on the executor
cancel calls cancelTransaction on the executor for each action
cancel reads the current proposal state before acting
the internal vote routine requires the proposal to be Active
the internal vote routine adds voting power to the for or against tallies in storage
onlyRole(OWNER_ROLE) updates the governance strategy address
onlyRole(OWNER_ROLE) updates the voting delay
onlyRole(ADD_EXECUTOR_ROLE) updates the authorized executors mapping
acceptAdmin sets the admin to msg.sender after the pending admin check
proposeRoot sets the waiting period end timestamp
proposeRoot reads the Merkle root data from the rewards oracle
updateRoot requires the waiting period end to have elapsed
updateRoot promotes the proposed root into the active root
mint advances the minting restriction time by the minimum mint interval
claim computes the vested amount from the vesting amount storage variable
getProposalState reads proposal flags and times from the proposals mapping
submitVote delegates to the internal vote routine with msg.sender

normalization_plan.reason: The executor parameter is only meaningful inside create, where it is stored on the proposal and checked against the authorized executors mapping.
The proposal id parameter is used solely inside execute to index the proposals mapping and drive executor calls.
The voter parameter is the internal routine's local identity used to look up and update the proposal vote.
The target parameter flows directly into the raw external call performed by the executor.
The call data parameter is executed against the target code in the executor storage context.
The signature component is consumed only by the ecrecover call that recovers the voter.
The deadline parameter is compared against block.timestamp inside permit and has no meaning elsewhere.
The CreateVars local struct only aggregates intermediate values used while building the new proposal.
The claimable local is computed and transferred within the internal claim routine and does not persist.
